entities.summary: Fritz Katzmann, also known as Friedrich Katzmann, was a German SS and Police Leader during the Nazi era. He perpetrated genocide in the cities of Kattowitz, Radom, Lemberg, Danzig, and across the Nazi occupied District of Galicia in the General Government during the Holocaust in Poland, making him a major figure during the Holocaust there.
